description: Fills a template with secrets from the vault and writes the result to a file that only the user can read (mode 0600). Placeholders look like {{ kz://<collection>/<item>/<field> }}. References look like "kz://<collection>/<item>/<field>" ("~" is the personal vault). Get them from search_items; never guess them. The file's content is not returned to you; do not read the written file back.

template.description: Template text. Use this or template_path.

template_path.description: Path of a template file, e.g. .env.tpl

name: inject_template
title: Write a config file with secrets
